purpose: Prospectively decide whether the standard vLLM OpenAI embedding input path is numerically and retrieval-equivalent to Mem-Gallery's pinned official direct LMEncoder implementation for NaiveRAG, before any real benchmark vector or score is observed.
scientific_question: Can the operationally convenient endpoint reproduce the official encoder's normalized vectors, pairwise retrieval scores, and complete deterministic rankings closely enough to preserve the registered NaiveRAG intervention?
estimand_boundary: This gate estimates implementation equivalence on frozen diagnostic probes. It does not estimate NaiveRAG quality, compare memory methods, select a reported metric, or authorize a SOTA claim.

official_implementation_identity.observed_behavior: LMEncoder tokenizes raw text, runs the model in evaluation mode, returns last_hidden_state[:, -1, :], and TextRetrieval cosine-normalizes the resulting tensor.

coverage: attribute collision and temporal update language

terminal_branches.ENDPOINT_EQUIVALENT: Only this branch permits the separately frozen real NaiveRAG lifecycle to use the vLLM input endpoint.
terminal_branches.DIRECT_ENCODER_REQUIRED: This is an accepted informative terminal result, not a failed experiment; the separately frozen lifecycle must use the official direct LMEncoder path.

artifact_contract.output_root: An absent non-symlink exact child of an explicitly allowed run scope.
artifact_contract.inputs: Absolute regular non-symlink UTF-8 JSON files whose source, model, pooling, precision, batch, probe identity, order, dimension, finiteness, and nonzero norms must match exactly.

covered_invariants: small retrieval-score drift selects the direct encoder
ranking drift selects the direct encoder
identity, order, dimension, and non-finite vector rejection
endpoint-equivalent terminal marker and signed audit creation
existing, nested, and symlink output-root rejection
malformed evidence rejection before output creation

next_gate: After WMA Wave 1 releases the GPUs, freeze and execute one direct probe capture and one float32 vLLM probe capture at the pinned model revision, audit them in a fresh root, then freeze the selected real NaiveRAG lifecycle branch before reading any Mem-Gallery score.
authorization: This synthetic-only gate authorizes no real model load, service launch, endpoint call, dataset read, prediction, score, comparison, claim, or cleanup.
